events.description:
What happened? What matters now? What comes next?

Created by The Media Collective, Faultline and decodeTV, OFF AIR brings together the people shaping streaming, broadcast and media to examine the technologies, business models and industry shifts that defined the past year, and the forces set to shape the next era of video.

From the lessons of streaming live sports at unprecedented scale and the changing relationship between broadcasters and platforms, to AI, monetisation and the infrastructure underpinning it all, OFF AIR asks where the industry goes next.

Part survival guide, part crystal ball, expect blunt lessons, provocative predictions, practical insight and audience-led debate.

events.subtitle: OFF AIR brings media leaders together to unpack 2026, challenge the consensus and debate what comes next for broadcast, streaming and video.
events.ctaCopy:
Interested in attending OFF AIR?

Attendance is limited and invitations are carefully curated to maintain the quality of the room and the connections made at every Media Collective event.

programme.description:
THE DEBRIEF

What did 2026 teach us?

We’ll revisit the moments, technologies and industry shifts that defined the year, exploring what worked, what didn’t and what the industry should take forward.

THE SURVIVAL GUIDE

A practical look at what is changing across content, production and delivery, separating what matters from what doesn’t and identifying where attention should be focused next.

UNFILTERED: ASK THE ANALYSTS

No presentations. No safe talking points.

An audience-led discussion that puts leading analysts and commentators in the hot seat. Bring your questions, challenge assumptions and expect candid answers.

FAULTLINE FUTURES

Bold predictions, provocative thinking and an audience test of the ideas most likely and least likely to shape the future of media.

DECODETV IMPACT AWARDS

Recognising the people, ideas and initiatives making an impact across broadcast, streaming and media technology.

events.description:
After four days of meetings, launches, panels and packed schedules, it is time to decompress.

The IBC Decompression Party brings together people from across broadcast, streaming and media technology for a relaxed final evening away from the exhibition floor.

Join us at Live Amsterdam Piano Bar for live jazz from LDN2BTN featuring the IBC Allstars, a Prosecco reception, complimentary drinks and canapés, with exclusive use of the outdoor terrace overlooking Thorbeckeplein.

No presentations. No conference agenda. Just a chance to unwind, catch up with familiar faces and meet a few new ones before IBC comes to a close.
events.seoDescription: An IBC social evening with live jazz, drinks and canapés at Live Amsterdam Piano Bar on 12 September 2027, featuring LDN2BTN and the IBC Allstars.

programme.description:
ARRIVE & DECOMPRESS

Step away from the exhibition halls and start the evening with a Prosecco reception at Live Amsterdam Piano Bar.

LIVE JAZZ

Enjoy live music from LDN2BTN featuring the IBC Allstars, bringing together musicians from across the industry for one of the more unusual fixtures of IBC week.

DRINKS & CANAPÉS

Complimentary drinks and a selection of canapés will be served throughout the evening.

THE TERRACE

Take advantage of exclusive access to the venue’s outdoor terrace overlooking Thorbeckeplein, right in the centre of Amsterdam.

GREAT COMPANY

Catch up with colleagues, make new introductions and spend time with people you may only have passed between meetings during the week.

events.details:
IBC is busy by design. The Decompression Party is the opposite.

It is a chance to put the meetings and schedules aside, spend time with the people behind the industry and enjoy the final evening of the show without another presentation to get to.

Come for a drink. Stay for the band.
